scenes.title: Dinner and an Uneasy Alliance
scenes.rationale: The uninterrupted camp conversation moves from reviewing Raven's Hold to choosing a route and negotiating cooperation with Vola.
scenes.overview: The party debates the storm, questions Vola, and agrees to travel west together.
scenes.transitionToNext: An overnight rest gives way to departure across the plains.

scenes.title: Journey to the Storm
scenes.rationale: Both travel days and the preparations at the storm's edge serve the same immediate goal: reach the storm and decide how to enter. The calendar change remains explicit in chronology.
scenes.overview: Travel through scorched plains; a vulture scouts the eye, and Vola stays outside as the party prepares to enter.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party enters the storm and encounters its active hazards.

scenes.title: Runes and the Wall of Wind
scenes.rationale: The magical compulsion and wind-wall rescue are successive obstacles in one continuous effort to reach the eye.
scenes.overview: Runes compel Delwath to attack Seeker; fierce winds scatter the party before Wellby rescues Kenzo and Riswynn.
scenes.transitionToNext: Reunited in the calm eye, the party can investigate the tower and its surroundings.

scenes.title: A Grave Beneath the Tower
scenes.rationale: The party remains together, surveying the sheltered camp, grave, tower, and magical node before choosing a scout.
scenes.overview: They discover a Sibyl-marked grave, signs of earlier travelers, and unusual materials around the ley-line node.
scenes.transitionToNext: Delwath turns invisible and leaves the group to explore inside.

scenes.title: Delwath and the Living Lightning
scenes.rationale: The reconnaissance, hostile encounter, escape, and immediate report form one continuous scouting attempt.
scenes.overview: Delwath explores the ruined tower, escapes a lightning creature, and reports a voice's answer about Agata.
scenes.transitionToNext: Back in shelter, the group shifts from reconnaissance to interpreting the discoveries and recovering.

scenes.title: Master Runes and Missing Stars
scenes.rationale: The group's discussion and short rest continue in the sheltered camp through the closing sky reveal.
scenes.overview: They connect the strange writing with master runes, rest, and discover that the Fox and Hunter are missing.
